home.title: Twitch VOD Archive
home.welcome: Welcome to my personal archive of Twitch stream VODs. Browse through past streams, search by game or tags, and watch content you might have missed.
home.howToUseDesc: You can browse all VODs on the VODs page, or use the search and filter options to find specific content:
home.searchByTitle: Search by title or game name using the search bar
home.filterByGame: Filter by game to see all VODs of a specific game
home.filterByTags: Filter by tags to find content with specific themes or activities
home.contactDesc: If you have any questions or suggestions about the VOD archive, feel free to reach out to me on Twitch or through any of my social media channels.

home.title: Twitch 影片庫
home.welcome: 歡迎來到我的 Twitch 直播影片庫。瀏覽過去的直播，按遊戲或標籤搜尋，觀看您可能錯過的內容。
home.howToUseDesc: 您可以在影片頁面瀏覽所有影片，或使用搜尋和過濾選項找到特定內容：
home.searchByTitle: 使用搜尋欄按標題或遊戲名稱搜尋
home.filterByGame: 按遊戲過濾以查看特定遊戲的所有影片
home.filterByTags: 按標籤過濾以找到具有特定主題或活動的內容
home.contactDesc: 如果您對影片庫有任何問題或建議，請通過 Twitch 或我的任何社交媒體渠道與我聯繫。
